# PR Review Checklist: Fix webview env propagation (#55)

**Purpose**: Requirements-quality review of the #55 spec, for a peer reviewing PR #60 (standard depth)
**Created**: 2026-11-18
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Environment Propagation Requirements

- [ ] CHK001 Is "before the web view is created" defined precisely enough to be checked, such as a named startup point, rather than left as a timing phrase? [Clarity, Spec §FR-001]
- [ ] CHK002 Are the "process-level environment" and the runtime's own env object defined once and named consistently across FR-001, FR-002 and FR-006? [Consistency, Spec §FR-001, §FR-002, §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK003 Is the detection condition (platform, Wayland session, NVIDIA module loaded) specified completely, including how Wayland is recognized? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001, §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK004 Is the behavior defined when the variable is already set, for every value including empty? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK005 Is the value the workaround writes (`1`) stated as a requirement rather than implied by the issue text? [Gap, Spec §FR-001]
- [ ] CHK006 Does the spec say what "continue starting" means when the native write fails, including whether a user-visible or logged signal is required? [Clarity, Spec §FR-005]

## Scenario and Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK007 Are requirements defined for systems where the C library mechanism is unavailable, such as non-glibc Linux, rather than only for "libc/ffi unavailable"? [Coverage, Gap, Spec §User Story 3]
- [ ] CHK008 Is repeated execution of the setup (idempotence) stated as a requirement, not only listed as an edge case? [Consistency, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK009 Are NVIDIA + X11 and Wayland without NVIDIA both explicitly in or out of scope? [Coverage, Spec §FR-004, §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK010 Is the case where the runtime-level write succeeds but the native write fails addressed as a defined outcome? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]

## Verification and Success Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK011 Can SC-001 be objectively measured, with a defined number of launches and a stated definition of "rendered UI"? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001]
- [ ] CHK012 Is SC-002 stated as a testable condition that distinguishes writing to the runtime env only from writing to the process environment? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002]
- [ ] CHK013 Is "at least one NVIDIA + Wayland machine" in FR-007 specific enough about distro, driver version and build channel to be repeatable? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK014 Does the spec define who confirms FR-007 and what evidence closes issue #55? [Gap, Spec §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK015 Do the success criteria align with the functional requirements, so every FR maps to at least one SC or acceptance scenario? [Traceability, Spec §FR-001 to §FR-008, §SC-001 to §SC-004]

## Dependencies and Assumptions

- [ ] CHK016 Is the assumption that the reporter's single-machine result is the root cause supported by a stated confirmation path? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK017 Is the dependency on the web view reading the variable from the process environment documented as an assumption, with its source? [Dependency, Gap, Spec §Assumptions]

## Notes

- Items are phrased as requirements-quality questions. `/speckit-implement` reads checklist state but does not modify markers.
- CHK011, CHK013 and CHK014 relate to the open manual verification (T014 and T015).
